Installing the SecureOS Netboot Server on a server using a bootable USB drive.
Before you begin, make sure you have the following:
 A Server to install SecureOS
 A bootable USB drive (created in DD mode)
 Active internet connection (through LAN only)
 A LAN cable (connected to a network with internet access)
 Installation key (this key is used for authentication; it can be used only once)
Installation Steps:
Step 1: Create a Bootable USB Drive
 Use BootMediaCreator to write the ISO to your USB drive using DD mode.
⚠Note: - Do not rename the ISO file. When creating the bootable USB, make sure the USB drive
name matches the ISO file name exactly. Once written in DD mode, the USB will not be
readable or editable via File Explorer — this is normal.
Step 2: Boot the Target System
 Insert the bootable USB into the target laptop/server.
 Boot the machine from the USB (you may need to select the USB from the boot
menu).
Step 3: Start the Installation Process
 Once the system boots from USB, a series of
command-line messages will appear.
 If you encounter the error "Kickstart
Insufficient" and the Begin Installation button
is disabled

Fix: "Kickstart Insufficient" / Disabled Begin Button
1. Click Installation Destination.
2. Click on HDD Icon , 2 times and then Click on
Done Button. (top-left).
Installing SecureOS Netboot Server
 You don’t need to do anything on this screen except click the
"Begin Installation" button at the bottom-right corner (blue
colour).
The installation process will start automatically please
wait patiently — this may take some time.

3. Click Reclaim Space on the pop-up.
4. Click Delete Button to clear old partitions.
5. Click Reclaim Space (bottom-right) to confirm.
Network Configuration (Black Screen Phase)
 After some time, a black screen will appear asking you to enter:
 IP Address
 Gateway
 DNS
 Key
 Type the details and Press Enter.
⚠ Note: - Make sure the LAN cable is properly connected and the IP
address has internet access. This step downloads essential system files
— if the internet disconnect, the installation may fail and the OS
won’t work properly.
Step 5: Completing Installation
 Once the process is done, the system will reboot automatically.
 After reboot, you’ll see the SecureOS screen.
⚠Note: - After OS is installed, the screen
may remain blank for a while. Do not
force shutdown of server. Wait till login
screen appears.
